title: Guha requests Lakshmana to take rest
introduction: Guha requests Lakshmana to take rest, duly expressing his readiness to guard Rama and his consort by keeping awake the whole night. Lakshmana expressed his unwillingness to lie down in the presence of his elder brother and sister in law and preferred to remain awake. He spends night talking with Guha, voicing grief for his royal father as well as his affectionate mothers.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अयोध्य काण्डे एकपंचाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 51th chapter in the AyodhyaKanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् जाग्रतम् अदम्भेन भ्रातुर् अर्थाय लक्ष्मणम् |
गुहः सम्ताप सम्तप्तः राघवम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam jāgratam adambhena bhrātur arthāya lakṣmaṇam |
guhaḥ samtāpa samtaptaḥ rāghavam vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Distressed with anguish (to see Rama and Sita lying on the ground) Guha said to Lakshmana, the scion of Raghu, who kept awake, through sincere love, for the protection of his brother Rama.

glosses.meaning: who was born in Raghu dynasty

verses.devanagari:
इयम् तात सुखा शय्या त्वद् अर्थम् उपकल्पिता |
प्रत्याश्वसिहि साध्व् अस्याम् राज पुत्र यथा सुखम्
verses.iast:
iyam tāta sukhā śayyā tvad artham upakalpitā |
pratyāśvasihi sādhv asyām rāja putra yathā sukham
verses.translation: "Here is a comfortable bed made for you, my friend! Relax well comfortably on it, Oh, prince!"

verses.devanagari:
उचितः अयम् जनः सर्वः क्लेशानाम् त्वम् सुख उचितः |
गुप्ति अर्थम् जागरिष्यामः काकुत्स्थस्य वयम् निशाम्
verses.iast:
ucitaḥ ayam janaḥ sarvaḥ kleśānām tvam sukha ucitaḥ |
gupti artham jāgariṣyāmaḥ kākutsthasya vayam niśām
verses.translation: "All of us are habituated to hardships. You are habituated to comforts. We shall keep awake this night, for the protection of Rama"

glosses.meaning: are habituated to comforts. Guptyartham = For the protection

verses.devanagari:
न हि रामात् प्रियतरः मम अस्ति भुवि कश्चन |
ब्रवीम्य् एतत् अहम् सत्यम् सत्येन एव च ते शपे
verses.iast:
na hi rāmāt priyataraḥ mama asti bhuvi kaścana |
bravīmy etat aham satyam satyena eva ca te śape
verses.translation: "For, none is dearer to me than Rama in this world. I speak the truth and swear to you by truth."

verses.devanagari:
अस्य प्रसादात् आशंसे लोके अस्मिन् सुमहद् यशः |
धर्म अवाप्तिम् च विपुलाम् अर्थ अवाप्तिम् च केवलाम्
verses.iast:
asya prasādāt āśaṃse loke asmin sumahad yaśaḥ |
dharma avāptim ca vipulām artha avāptim ca kevalām
verses.translation: "I hope to acquire abundant acclaim and supreme merit in this world as also full reward of wealth, by the sole grace of Rama"

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् प्रिय सखम् रामम् शयानम् सह सीतया |
रक्षिष्यामि धनुष् पाणिः सर्वतः ज्ञातिभिः सह
verses.iast:
so aham priya sakham rāmam śayānam saha sītayā |
rakṣiṣyāmi dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ sarvataḥ GYātibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: "As such, I along with my kindred, shall protect my dear friend Rama who is reposing with Sita in every way, with bow in hand."

verses.devanagari:
न हि मे अविदितम् किंचित् वने अस्मिमः चरतः सदा |
चतुर् अन्गम् हि अपि बलम् सुमहत् प्रसहेमहि
verses.iast:
na hi me aviditam kiṃcit vane asmimḥ carataḥ sadā |
catur angam hi api balam sumahat prasahemahi
verses.translation: "Nothing is indeed unknown in this forest to me, where I wander continually. We can able to withstand even a vast army too, comprising of four parts (elephants, chariots, cavalry, and infantry)."

glosses.meaning: continually. prasahemahi = We are able to withstand

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः तम् तदा उवाच रक्ष्यमाणाः त्वया अनघ |
न अत्र भीता वयम् सर्वे धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ tam tadā uvāca rakṣyamāṇāḥ tvayā anagha |
na atra bhītā vayam sarve dharmam eva anupaśyatā
verses.translation: Then, Lakshmana replied to Guha as follows: "Oh, sinless Guha! Being protected by you, who keep your duty alone in view, all of us are fearless in this land."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया |
शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धुम् जीवितम् वा सुखानि वा
verses.iast:
katham dāśarathau bhūmau śayāne saha sītayā |
śakyā nidrā mayā labdhum jīvitam vā sukhāni vā
verses.translation: "When Rama, the son of Dasaratha is lying on the ground with Sita, how is it possible for me to sleep or to enjoy the pleasures of life?"

verses.devanagari:
यो न देव असुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुम् युधि |
तम् पश्य सुख सम्विष्टम् तृणेषु सह सीतया
verses.iast:
yo na deva asuraiḥ sarvaiḥ śakyaḥ prasahitum yudhi |
tam paśya sukha samviṣṭam tṛṇeṣu saha sītayā
verses.translation: "See that Rama, who cannot be vanquished in combat even by the gods and demons combined, now sleeping profoundly on the grass along with Sita."

verses.devanagari:
यो मन्त्र तपसा लब्धो विविधैः च परिश्रमैः |
एको दशरथस्य एष पुत्रः सदृश लक्षणः
अस्मिन् प्रव्रजितः राजा न चिरम् वर्तयिष्यति |
विधवा मेदिनी नूनम् क्षिप्रम् एव भविष्यति
verses.iast:
yo mantra tapasā labdho vividhaiḥ ca pariśramaiḥ |
eko daśarathasya eṣa putraḥ sadṛśa lakṣaṇaḥ
asmin pravrajitaḥ rājā na ciram vartayiṣyati |
vidhavā medinī nūnam kṣipram eva bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: When Rama- who is endowed with similar characteristics as Dasaratha, uniquely beloved, the son obtained by Dasaratha by virtue of his chanting of several sacred texts and austerities and by various undertakings (in the form of sacrificial performances) has gone to exile, the king will not live long and the earth will become surely widowed forthwith.

glosses.meaning: by virtue of his charity of sacred texts and austerities

verses.devanagari:
विनद्य सुमहा नादम् श्रमेण उपरताः स्त्रियः |
निर्घोष उपरतम् तात मन्ये राज निवेशनम्
verses.iast:
vinadya sumahā nādam śrameṇa uparatāḥ striyaḥ |
nirghoṣa uparatam tāta manye rāja niveśanam
verses.translation: Having cried out in a high-pitched tone, the women having exhausted, will have fallen silent and I am sure that a profound stillness reigns in the palace.

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथैव जननी मम |
न आशंसे यदि जीवन्ति सर्वे ते शर्वरीम् इमाम्
verses.iast:
kausalyā caiva rājā ca tathaiva jananī mama |
na āśaṃse yadi jīvanti sarve te śarvarīm imām
verses.translation: "I do not expect Kausalya, Dasaratha and my mother all of them to remain alive for this night."

verses.devanagari:
जीवेद् अपि हि मे माता शत्रुघ्नस्य अन्ववेक्षया |
तत् दुह्खम् यत् तु कौसल्या वीरसूर् विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
jīved api hi me mātā śatrughnasya anvavekṣayā |
tat duhkham yat tu kausalyā vīrasūr vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: "By looking forward to meet Satrughna, my mother might even stay alive. But it will be painful if Kausalya who has given birth to a heroic son, dies."

glosses.meaning: may indeed stay alive. tat = It will be
who has given birth to a hero

verses.devanagari:
अनुरक्त जन आकीर्णा सुख आलोक प्रिय आवहा |
राज व्यसन संसृष्टा सा पुरी विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
anurakta jana ākīrṇā sukha āloka priya āvahā |
rāja vyasana saṃsṛṣṭā sā purī vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: That city of Ayodhya, filled with devoted people, hitherto a source of joy and which brought pleasure to the world, when seized with agony over the king's death, will perish.

glosses.meaning: and which brought pleasure to the world
when seized with sorrow over the king's death

verses.devanagari:
कथम् पुत्रम् महात्मानम् ज्येष्ठम् प्रियमपस्यतः |
शरीरम् धारयुष्यान्ति प्राणा राज्ञो महात्मनः
verses.iast:
katham putram mahātmānam jyeśhṭham priyamapasyataḥ |
śarīram dhārayuśhyānti prāṇā rājJṇo mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "How, in the absence of his magnanimous and the first born son, will the vital airs in the body of the generous king be maintained?"

verses.devanagari:
विनष्टे नृपतौ पश्चात्कौसल्या विनशिष्यति |
अनन्तरम् च माताऽपि मम नाशमुपैष्यति
verses.iast:
vinaśhṭe nṛpatau paścātkausalyā vinaśiśhyati |
anantaram ca mātā'pi mama nāśamupaiśhyati
verses.translation: "After the death of king, Kausalya will die. My mother also will die thereafter.

verses.devanagari:
अतिक्रान्तम् अतिक्रान्तम् अनवाप्य मनोरथम् |
राज्ये रामम् अनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
atikrāntam atikrāntam anavāpya manoratham |
rājye rāmam anikṣipya pitā me vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: "Having failed to install Rama in the kingdom, failed forever, which was the most cherished wish of his heart, my father will leave this world.

glosses.meaning: his desire( to enthrone Rama) atikraantamatikraantam = going astray again and again

verses.devanagari:
सिद्ध अर्थाः पितरम् वृत्तम् तस्मिन् काले हि उपस्थिते |
प्रेत कार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम्
verses.iast:
siddha arthāḥ pitaram vṛttam tasmin kāle hi upasthite |
preta kāryeṣu sarveṣu saṃskariṣyanti bhūmipam
verses.translation: "Those who are fortunate will consecrate our deceased father and the king in the course of all funeral rites, when the hour has struck.

glosses.meaning: in the course of all funeral rites

verses.devanagari:
रम्य चत्वर संस्थानाम् सुविभक्त महा पथाम् |
हर्म्य प्रसाद सम्पन्नाम् गणिका वर शोभिताम्
रथ अश्व गज सम्बाधाम् तूर्य नाद विनादिताम् |
सर्व कल्याण सम्पूर्णाम् हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकुलाम्
आराम उद्यान सम्पन्नाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनीम् |
सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राज धानीम् पितुर् मम
verses.iast:
ramya catvara saṃsthānām suvibhakta mahā pathām |
harmya prasāda sampannām gaṇikā vara śobhitām
ratha aśva gaja sambādhām tūrya nāda vināditām |
sarva kalyāṇa sampūrṇām hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana ākulām
ārāma udyāna sampannām samāja utsava śālinīm |
sukhitā vicariṣyanti rāja dhānīm pitur mama
verses.translation: People will joyfully move in the capital belonging to my father and the city with its quadrangular places allocated at lovely sites, and well- aligned roads, rich in mansions of well-to-do men, temples and royal palaces adorned with the foremost of courtesans, its chariots horses and elephants that obstruct the roads, the musical instruments that resound there- full of all blessings and crowded with merry and well fed men, well- provided with gardens and royal parks and bright with festivities carried on under the patronage of associations.

glosses.meaning: with its quadrangular places allocated at lovely sites
rich in mansions of well-to-do men and temples
adorned with the foremost of courtesans
the musical instruments that resound there
crowded with merry and well- fed men
well- provided with gardens and royal parks
(and) bright with festivities carried on under the patronage of associations.

verses.devanagari:
अपि जीवेद्धशरथो वनवासात्पुनर्वयम् |
प्रत्यागम्य महात्मानमपि पश्येम सुव्रतम्
verses.iast:
api jīveddhaśaratho vanavāsātpunarvayam |
pratyāgamya mahātmānamapi paśyema suvratam
verses.translation: Will Dasaratha remain alive? After returning from exile, can we see the high-soled king Dasaratha of noble vows again?

glosses.meaning: Will Dasaratha remain alive? pratyaagamya = After returning

verses.devanagari:
अपि सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन सार्धम् कुशलिना वयम् |
निवृत्ते वन वासे अस्मिन्न् अयोध्याम् प्रविशेमहि
verses.iast:
api satya pratiGYena sārdham kuśalinā vayam |
nivṛtte vana vāse asminn ayodhyām praviśemahi
verses.translation: Can we safely return to Ayodhya, after completion of the exile in the forest along with Rama who is faithful to his promises?

glosses.meaning: after completion of the exile in the forest
who is faithful to his promises.

verses.devanagari:
परिदेवयमानस्य दुह्ख आर्तस्य महात्मनः |
तिष्ठतः राज पुत्रस्य शर्वरी सा अत्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
paridevayamānasya duhkha ārtasya mahātmanaḥ |
tiṣṭhataḥ rāja putrasya śarvarī sā atyavartata
verses.translation: While the high-soled Lakshmana thus lamenting, stood on ground, afflicted with anguish as he was, that night rolled away.

glosses.meaning: afflicated with anguish as he was

verses.devanagari:
तथा हि सत्यम् ब्रुवति प्रजा हिते |
नर इन्द्र पुत्रे गुरु सौहृदात् गुहः |
मुमोच बाष्पम् व्यसन अभिपीडितः |
ज्वरा आतुरः नागैव व्यथा आतुरः
verses.iast:
tathā hi satyam bruvati prajā hite |
nara indra putre guru sauhṛdāt guhaḥ |
mumoca bāṣpam vyasana abhipīḍitaḥ |
jvarā āturaḥ nāgaiva vyathā āturaḥ
verses.translation: While Lakshmana (son of Dasaratha), who was concerned with the welfare of the people; was thus speaking the truth out of his affection for his elder brother (Rama), Guha, overcome with agony and oppressed with adversity shed tears like an elephant tormented with fever.

glosses.meaning: who was concerned with the welfare of the people
out of his affection for his elder brother (Rama)
